interpretation_ko: 즐거운 모임과 흥미로운 일을 뜻하는 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes pleasant entertainments and interesting affairs

cite.original: To dream of peppermint, denotes pleasant entertainments and interesting affairs.
cite.translation_ko: 박하 꿈은, 즐거운 모임과 흥미로운 일을 뜻하는 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that you will participate in some pleasure in which there will be a dash of romance

cite.original: To see it growing, denotes that you will participate in some pleasure in which there will be a dash of romance.
cite.translation_ko: 자라는 박하를 보는 꿈은, 낭만이 깃든 즐거움을 누릴 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 매력적이고 홀리는 이와 은밀한 만남을 즐길 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that you will enjoy assignations with some attractive and fascinating person

cite.original: To enjoy drinks in which there is an effusion of peppermint, denotes that you will enjoy assignations with some attractive and fascinating person.
cite.translation_ko: 박하 향이 나는 음료를 즐기는 꿈은, 매력적이고 홀리는 이와 은밀한 만남을 즐길 조짐이다

context: 처녀가 박하 향이 나는 음료를 즐기는 꿈을 꿈
interpretation_en: this dream warns her against seductive pleasures

cite.original: To a young woman, this dream warns her against seductive pleasures.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 박하 향이 나는 음료를 즐기는 꿈은, 홀리는 즐거움을 조심하라는 경고다
